summary.name: 商量 (SenseChat)
summary.one_liner: SenseChat (商量) is a Chinese-language AI chat assistant from SenseTime that answers questions, writes text, makes images, and helps with code and document or paper reading.
use_cases: Drafting social media posts and PPT outlines
Summarizing PDF reports and academic papers
Generating images, cartoon avatars and logos
summary.what_it_does: The page is a landing page for SenseChat (商量), presented as an AI chat and Q&A assistant. It advertises summarizing financial news, interpreting policy, and analyzing financial reports. It also lists example tasks such as writing copy, generating images, writing code, and creative writing like poems. Demo prompts on the page cover Xiaohongshu-style notes, PPT outlines, English dialogue practice, and Python code. The page also shows document features: summarizing uploaded PDFs and translating or interpreting English articles and academic papers. Specific limits, model details, and pricing are not stated on the page.
notable: Supports PDF document summarization and paper interpretation
Image generation from text prompts, including cartoon avatars and logos
Chinese-language interface aimed at everyday and study tasks
Listed as free in the source collection
caveats: Pricing details are not stated on the page; the free label comes from the listing
Specific usage limits and paid tiers are not described on the page
